approval.decision: Kris said "Okay this mock is approved" after reviewing annotated screenshots of the combined Story layout following three council rounds. Approve combined-v1, named "Story Combined v1", with the recorded source, captures and behaviour. It is the target Story workspace for later implementation work.
behaviour: A 16:9 game stage and a right-hand beat editor sit above a bottom panel that switches between Tracks and Reel; Writing focus hides the stage and keeps the editor, the Branch path and a resizable lane grid from 900 px.
The Branch path bar only switches branches with If / Else if / Otherwise and numbered option switches. It wraps; each extra row takes about 30 px from the stage.

Open branches draw an arm-coloured route line in the Tracks/Reel row, with the legend in Key. An empty branch or option is one named, selectable slot. A branch end keeps its + only before a Jump or Return; every expanded condition keeps an after marker.
Backgrounds and expressions use picker sheets in the sidebar that preview on the stage. Add a beat is a compact dialog: click or Enter adds, Escape cancels, and it shrinks to its results.
Conditions use the typed rule builder; half-typed numbers stay drafts in the field with a message and never reach the story. Set variable is the equation row (#88).

Choice options are numbered blocks that own beats, a Then ending (Continue, Go to a scene, Repeat this Choice, Return), an Only when condition with Hide or Show disabled, and move up/down that keeps identity. Picked options are Show normally, Mark picked or Hide picked; Preview options sit outside Undo (#99).
Brass and slate palette per theme; colour marks only branch arms, character names and selection, as recorded in docs/UI.md.
deviations: Fictional browser-memory mock. Choice bodies, prompts, Hide/Show disabled, Repeat and Picked options (#98) and arithmetic (#87) are not implemented in production and the mock labels them as planned.
A multi-row Branch path can shrink the stage below the 960 x 540 minimum in #82; Kris accepted this. One-row paths keep 974 x 548 at 1600 x 1000 and 633 x 356 at 1100 x 720.
The final council rounds scored Opus 9.1 and Sol 9.2 before a gate cap; their remaining findings were fixed in this source without a further scored round.

The branching sample state renders like populated in this layout. Recorded captures cover distinct sample states only; interaction references for nested branches, the Choice editor and Writing focus are linked from the design notes.
